intro: The Kodo Graveyard is a sprawling expanse in central Desolace littered with the massive, bleached remains of ancient beasts. By instinct or tradition, aging and dying kodos make a final pilgrimage to this desolate hollow to collapse among the ribs of their ancestors.

p: Sprawling across the grey earth of Desolace, the Kodo Graveyard holds the colossal skeletons of ancient beasts, some far larger than any living kodo seen today. Dying kodos wander here to spend their final breaths among centuries of accumulated remains. This sacred peace is fragile: scavengers prowl the perimeter, and those who disturb the calcified ribs and skulls risk stirring furious kodo spirits from the dust.

The boundary between the living and the dead wears exceptionally thin across the bone fields. Travelers who peer into the spirit realm find restless, towering kodo apparitions wandering silently among the dust storms. Nearby, the Horde maintains Ghost Walker Post, watching over the sacred grounds and keeping a wary eye on the wandering herds and spectral manifestations that linger around the bones.
